text: にげられて　しまった・・・

structure.jp: にげられて　しまった・・・

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.span: にげられて　しまった
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing happened completely, often to your regret. にげられて しまった = 'it went and got away'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: られる here shows that someone else's action happened to you and you suffered from it. にげられて = 'had it run away on me'.
